data.value: Will the residents' petition against the Riverton quarry extension collect the 1,500 signatures needed to trigger a council debate before the submission deadline in six weeks?

The Riverton quarry extension is a local issue. A petition is being circulated to trigger a council debate, requiring 1,500 signatures by the submission deadline in six weeks (2026-09-14T17:00:00-06:00). The organizers have 400 signatures so far. The quarry operator distributed a counter-flyer last week. The town population is 19,000; the quarry employs 85 residents.
